id.description: Optional container id; generated if empty

image.description: Image ref as stored after pull (e.g. `nginx:alpine`)

restart.description: Restart policy (`always`, `on-failure`, `unless-stopped`, `never`, …); default `never`, as in Docker

stream.description:
When true, use `application/x-ndjson` for the response if a pull is needed or for the terminal `run` line when no pull (same event schema as `POST /v1/images/pull` plus final `phase: run`).
Ignored when the request uses `application/x-nyxd-run+v1` (attached stdin/TTY).

tty.description: Allocate a PTY for the container init (`nyx run -t` / docker `-t`)

stdin.description:
Keep init stdin open. With `Content-Type: application/x-nyxd-run+v1`, bytes after the
JSON header line are streamed to stdin (`nyx run -i` / docker `-i`).

auto_remove.description:
Delete container logs when the workload exits and will not restart (`nyx run --rm`).
Incompatible with restart `always` / `unless-stopped`.

volumes.description:
Bind mounts, `SRC:DST[:ro|rw]` (`nyx run -v`). SRC is an absolute path on the nyxd
host and must exist; DST is absolute.

network.description:
`host` shares the host's network namespace (`nyx run --network host`); cannot be
combined with published ports. Unset, `bridge` or `default` use the daemon's driver.

memory_swap.description: Memory plus swap; equal to `memory` means no swap (`nyx run --memory-swap`)

cpus.description: CPU limit in cores, e.g. `0.5` (`nyx run --cpus`)

pids_limit.description: Maximum number of processes in the container (`nyx run --pids-limit`)

oom_score_adj.description: OOM killer preference for the container init (`nyx run --oom-score-adj`)

read_only.description: Mount the root filesystem read-only (`nyx run --read-only`)

tmpfs.description:
tmpfs mounts, `PATH[:OPTIONS]` (`nyx run --tmpfs`). Defaults to `nosuid,nodev,noexec`;
`suid`, `dev`, `exec`, `ro`, `size=`, `mode=`, `uid=`, `gid=` and `nr_inodes=` are accepted.

rows.description: Initial PTY height when `tty` is true

cols.description: Initial PTY width when `tty` is true

healthcheck.description: Optional readiness and ongoing checks. The daemon waits until the first successful probe (within a bounded budget) before returning from a non-streaming run, then continues checking in the background. Unhealthy transitions trigger a kill so restart policy can respawn the workload.

command.description: Required for `exec` — argv inside the container (`crun exec`).

interval.description: Go duration string for background checks (e.g. `30s`).

start_period.description: Grace period before failures count (Go duration).

healthcheck.title: RunHealthcheck

registry_username.description: Optional registry credentials when a pull is required before run

application/x-nyxd-run+v1.description: JSON header line (RunRequest) then raw stdin until EOF (`nyx run -i` / `-it`).
